metric_definitions.scr: Correct final values for conflict rows only, scored across both replicas; null when no conflicts.
metric_definitions.row_value_agreement_rate: Matching ordered bench_rows.value values across the two replicas; not full-database convergence.
metric_definitions.vra: Not measured by this workload because it defines no domain range or relational constraints.

environment.journal_mode: DELETE (verified for benchmark base and replica connections per trial)
environment.measurement_scope: sequential replica-local writes followed by one batch synchronization per system per trial

configuration.sync_mode: sequential tracked writes followed by pairwise batch sync
sequential tracked writes followed by pairwise batch sync

workload_mode: sequential local writes followed by batch synchronization

timing_boundaries.tracked_write_latency_ms: wall time around each apply_change call, including local SQLite mutation and change-log capture; sequential calls
timing_boundaries.batch_sync_ms: wall time around sync_replicas only; excludes database creation and tracked writes
timing_boundaries.batch_sync_delta_ms: paired per-trial SemanticSync batch sync minus LWW batch sync
